description: Confirm a USDC/USDT sandbox payment_request with a FAKE transaction hash (EVM: 0x + 64 hex; Tron: 64 hex; Solana: base58 signature). Hashes ending in 'dead' simulate a reverted tx, 'beef' an underpayment. Requests expire after 15 minutes.
name: confirm_crypto_payment
title: Confirm a simulated stablecoin payment
